provider: claude files api as an archive

free_tier.stated: 1 TB total storage for each organization and 500 MB for each file; Files API operations are free. Files that are uploaded cannot be downloaded (write-only): only files created by skills or the code execution tool can be downloaded. The 1 TB limit is for each organization, so its workspaces add no space.

retention.stated: Files persist until deleted with DELETE /v1/files/{file_id} or until their expires_at, which is optional and set at upload between 1 hour and 90 days.

egress.terms: Files that are uploaded cannot be downloaded: downloading an uploaded file returns a 400 error, and only files created by skills or the code execution tool can be downloaded. Files API operations are free.

interface_detail: REST endpoints under /v1/files: upload, list, retrieve metadata, delete; content download only for files generated by skills or the code execution tool
tooling: Files API of the Claude API through its SDKs and the ant CLI; file-related API calls are limited to approximately 500 requests per minute.
